from datetime import datetime
from typing import Annotated

from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Query, status
from sqlalchemy import select
from sqlalchemy.ext.asyncio import AsyncSession

from recipe_box.db import get_session
from recipe_box.models import Recipe
from recipe_box.schemas import RecipeCreate, RecipeOut, RecipePage
from recipe_box.text import slugify

router = APIRouter(prefix="/recipes", tags=["recipes"])
Session = Annotated[AsyncSession, Depends(get_session)]


@router.get("", response_model=RecipePage)
async def list_recipes(
    session: Session,
    q: str | None = None,
    page: int = Query(1, ge=1),
    size: int = Query(20, ge=1, le=100),
):
    stmt = select(Recipe).order_by(Recipe.created_at.desc())
    if q:
        stmt = stmt.where(Recipe.title.ilike(f"%{q}%"))
    rows = (await session.scalars(stmt.offset((page - 1) * size).limit(size))).all()
    return RecipePage(items=[RecipeOut.model_validate(r) for r in rows], page=page, size=size)


@router.get("/{slug}", response_model=RecipeOut)
async def get_recipe(slug: str, session: Session):
    recipe = await session.scalar(select(Recipe).where(Recipe.slug == slug))
    if recipe is None:
        raise HTTPException(status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, "recipe not found")
    return recipe


@router.post("", response_model=RecipeOut, status_code=status.HTTP_201_CREATED)
async def create_recipe(body: RecipeCreate, session: Session):
    slug = slugify(body.title)
    if await session.scalar(select(Recipe.id).where(Recipe.slug == slug)):
        raise HTTPException(status.HTTP_409_CONFLICT, "slug already used")
    recipe = Recipe(**body.model_dump(), slug=slug, created_at=datetime.utcnow())
    session.add(recipe)
    await session.commit()
    await session.refresh(recipe)
    return recipe


@router.delete("/{slug}", status_code=status.HTTP_204_NO_CONTENT)
async def delete_recipe(slug: str, session: Session):
    recipe = await session.scalar(select(Recipe).where(Recipe.slug == slug))
    if recipe is None:
        raise HTTPException(status.HTTP_404_NOT_FOUND, "recipe not found")
    await session.delete(recipe)
    await session.commit()

GO       ?= go
PKG      := ./...
BIN      := bin/tilemux
VERSION  := $(shell git describe --tags --always --dirty)
LDFLAGS  := -s -w -X main.version=$(VERSION)

all: lint test build

build:
	mkdir -p bin
	$(GO) build -trimpath -ldflags '$(LDFLAGS)' -o $(BIN) ./cmd/tilemux

test:
	$(GO) test -race -count=1 $(PKG)

lint:
	golangci-lint run --timeout 3m

fmt:
	gofumpt -l -w .

generate:
	protoc -I proto --go_out=gen --go_opt=paths=source_relative proto/tile/v1/*.proto

docker-up:
	docker compose -f deploy/compose.dev.yml up -d

docker-down:
	docker compose -f deploy/compose.dev.yml down

migrate:
	migrate -path db/migrations -database "$$DATABASE_URL" up

# Removes build outputs only.
clean:
	rm -rf bin/ dist/ coverage.out

# Also drops generated code and the module cache: slow to rebuild.
distclean: clean
	rm -rf gen/
	$(GO) clean -modcache -cache -testcache
	git clean -fdX

# Release helpers.
release-notes:
\tgit log --pretty='- %s (%h)' $$(git describe --tags --abbrev=0)..HEAD

bench:
\t$(GO) test -run '^$$' -bench . -benchmem ./internal/tiles/ | tee bench.txt

coverage:
\t$(GO) test -coverprofile=coverage.out $(PKG)

# rastr

A tiny software rasterizer in modern C++ (C++20). It draws lines, filled polygons and
anti-aliased strokes into an RGBA canvas and can write PNG files without external
dependencies.

## Building

```sh
cmake -S . -B build -G Ninja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release
cmake --build build
```

Options:

| Option | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `RASTR_BUILD_TESTS` | `ON` | build the doctest suite |
| `RASTR_ENABLE_ASAN` | `OFF` | AddressSanitizer in Debug builds |
| `RASTR_WARNINGS_AS_ERRORS` | `ON` | `-Werror` on GCC and Clang |

## Running the tests

```sh
ctest --test-dir build --output-on-failure
```

## Usage

```cpp
#include <rastr/canvas.hpp>
#include <rastr/png_writer.hpp>

int main() {
    rastr::Canvas c{256, 256, rastr::Color::white()};
    c.line({10, 10}, {245, 200}, rastr::Color::rgb(200, 30, 30), 2.0f);
    c.fill_polygon({{40, 220}, {128, 120}, {216, 220}}, rastr::Color::rgb(30, 90, 200));
    rastr::write_png(c, "out.png");
}
```

## Layout

- `include/rastr/` public headers
- `src/` implementation
- `tests/` unit tests (doctest)
- `bench/` micro benchmarks (not built by default)

## Cleaning up

`rm -rf build/` removes every build output; nothing is written outside the build tree.

## License

MIT, see `LICENSE`.

import ast
import pathlib
import sys

ROOT = pathlib.Path("src/recipe_box")
OLD_MOD = "recipe_box.legacy.http"
NEW_MOD = "recipe_box.net.client"
RENAMES = {"fetch_json": "get_json", "post_form": "post_data", "LegacySession": "Session"}

changed = []
for path in sorted(ROOT.rglob("*.py")):
    text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    try:
        tree = ast.parse(text)
    except SyntaxError as exc:
        print(f"skip {path}: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
        continue
    uses = any(
        isinstance(node, ast.ImportFrom) and node.module == OLD_MOD
        for node in ast.walk(tree)
    )
    if not uses:
        continue
    new = text.replace(f"from {OLD_MOD} import", f"from {NEW_MOD} import")
    for old, repl in RENAMES.items():
        new = new.replace(f"{old}(", f"{repl}(").replace(f" {old},", f" {repl},")
    if new != text:
        path.write_text(new, encoding="utf-8")
        changed.append(str(path))

legacy = ROOT / "legacy" / "http.py"
if legacy.exists() and changed:
    legacy.unlink()
    print("removed", legacy)

print(f"{len(changed)} files rewritten")
for p in changed:

    {
        $query = Appointment::query()
            ->with(['patient:id,name', 'practitioner:id,name'])
            ->orderBy('starts_at');

        if ($request->filled('practitioner_id')) {
            $query->where('practitioner_id', $request->integer('practitioner_id'));
        }
        if ($request->filled('day')) {
            $day = Carbon::parse($request->string('day'));
            $query->whereBetween('starts_at', [$day->copy()->startOfDay(), $day->copy()->endOfDay()]);
        }

        return response()->json($query->paginate(25));
    }

    public function store(StoreAppointmentRequest $request): JsonResponse
    {
        $data = $request->validated();
        $practitioner = Practitioner::findOrFail($data['practitioner_id']);
        $start = Carbon::parse($data['starts_at']);
        $end = $start->copy()->addMinutes($data['duration'] ?? 30);

        $overlap = $practitioner->appointments()
            ->where('starts_at', '<', $end)
            ->where('ends_at', '>', $start)
            ->exists();
        if ($overlap) {
            return response()->json(['message' => 'Slot already taken'], 409);
        }

        $appointment = $practitioner->appointments()->create([
            'patient_id' => $data['patient_id'],
            'starts_at' => $start,
            'ends_at' => $end,
            'notes' => $data['notes'] ?? null,
        ]);

        return response()->json($appointment->load('patient:id,name'), 201);
    }

    public function destroy(Appointment $appointment): JsonResponse
    {
        $this->authorize('delete', $appointment);
        $appointment->delete();

        return response()->json(null, 204);
    }
}

RSpec.describe Ticket, type: :model do
  let(:requester) { create(:user) }
  let(:agent) { create(:user, :agent) }

  describe "validations" do
    it "requires a subject" do
      ticket = build(:ticket, subject: "")
      expect(ticket).not_to be_valid
      expect(ticket.errors[:subject]).to include("can't be blank")
    end

    it "limits the subject to 200 characters" do
      expect(build(:ticket, subject: "a" * 201)).not_to be_valid
    end
  end

  describe "#assign!" do
    let(:ticket) { create(:ticket, requester: requester) }

    it "sets the agent and moves the ticket to open" do
      ticket.assign!(agent)
      expect(ticket.reload).to have_attributes(assignee: agent, status: "open")
    end

    it "refuses a non-agent user" do
      expect { ticket.assign!(requester) }.to raise_error(Ticket::NotAnAgent)
    end

    it "records an audit event" do
      expect { ticket.assign!(agent) }.to change { ticket.events.count }.by(1)
    end
  end

  describe ".overdue" do
    it "returns open tickets older than the SLA" do
      old = create(:ticket, status: "open", created_at: 3.days.ago)
      create(:ticket, status: "open", created_at: 1.hour.ago)
      create(:ticket, status: "closed", created_at: 5.days.ago)
      expect(Ticket.overdue(sla: 48.hours)).to contain_exactly(old)
    end
  end

  describe "#close!" do
    it "destroys pending reminders" do
      ticket = create(:ticket, :with_reminders, assignee: agent)
      expect { ticket.close! }.to change(Reminder, :count).to(0)
    end
  end

import sys
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
from collections import defaultdict

tree = ET.parse(sys.argv[1])
root = tree.getroot()
total = float(root.get("line-rate", 0)) * 100
print(f"total line coverage: {total:.1f}%")

by_pkg = defaultdict(lambda: [0, 0])
worst = []
for cls in root.iter("class"):
    filename = cls.get("filename")
    lines = cls.findall("./lines/line")
    hit = sum(1 for l in lines if int(l.get("hits", 0)) > 0)
    pkg = filename.rsplit("/", 1)[0] if "/" in filename else "."
    by_pkg[pkg][0] += hit
    by_pkg[pkg][1] += len(lines)
    if lines:
        missing = [int(l.get("number")) for l in lines if int(l.get("hits", 0)) == 0]
        worst.append((hit / len(lines), filename, missing))

print()
print(f"{'package':40} {'lines':>7} {'cover':>7}")
for pkg, (hit, n) in sorted(by_pkg.items()):
    pct = 100 * hit / n if n else 100.0
    flag = "  <-- below 80%" if pct < 80 else ""
    print(f"{pkg:40} {n:7d} {pct:6.1f}%{flag}")

print()
print("ten least covered files:")
for rate, name, missing in sorted(worst)[:10]:
    ranges, start, prev = [], None, None
    for n in missing:
        if start is None:
            start = prev = n
        elif n == prev + 1:
            prev = n
        else:
            ranges.append(f"{start}-{prev}" if start != prev else str(start))
            start = prev = n
    if start is not None:
        ranges.append(f"{start}-{prev}" if start != prev else str(start))
    print(f"  {rate*100:5.1f}%  {name}  missing: {', '.join(ranges[:6])}{' ...' if len(ranges) > 6 else ''}")
